entries.name: Shaman
entries: Shaman are spiritual adepts who commune with the elemental forces of the world and channel their power. These elemental forces are chaotic and, left to their own devices, would rage against each other in unending primal fury. A shaman's call is to bring balance to this chaos, acting as a moderator among air, earth, fire, and water. A shaman's magic focuses the elements to support the shaman's allies or punish those who threaten them.
Shaman are fierce warriors who wield their elemental magic as totems placed on the ground or auras that surround the shaman, rather than traditional spellcasting.
